item.title: Seven-day health trends at a glance
item.summary: Ask Murph for a compact seven-day view of steps, sleep, resting heart rate, and method-specific HRV, with missing days kept visible.
item.details: Metric selections can be saved for reuse without creating a schedule. For scheduled views, Murph distinguishes a provider send from unconfirmed handset delivery.

tryIt.label: Show my health trends
tryIt.prompt: Show my steps, sleep, resting heart rate, and HRV for the last seven days.
